propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds an MSc in Operational Research, awarded with merit in November 2018, as confirmed in writing by the University of Kelsall registrar.
propositions.rationale: The education verification records the registrar's written confirmation of the award.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate recalibrated the card-not-present fraud model every quarter and compared each recalibration with the live model on a holdout month.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the recalibrations and the work sample shows one change note with its windows and approval.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote model change notes for each recalibration and presented them to the model risk committee.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the documentation work and the work sample includes the committee's approval minute.

expectedGap: Network or graph features linking cards, devices and merchants are not documented; the feature work covers velocity features.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the registrar-confirmed MSc and the documented recalibration, monitoring and model-change work; do not extend the velocity features into graph-feature experience.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has built features from links between cards, devices and merchants, and how they were evaluated.
